title: Spinning Galaxies
text: How did we realize that most of reality was missing? The answer did not come from a single dramatic moment.
nxt: It came from astronomers who looked closely at something that seemed ordinary: how spiral galaxies rotate.

title: The Universe Speeds Up
text: As if a missing 27 percent were not baffling enough, the universe had an even bigger surprise waiting for us.
nxt: For decades, scientists assumed that gravity would gradually slow down the expansion of the universe that began with the Big Bang.

text: It seemed natural. Throw a ball upward, and gravity slows it down.

title: The Universe Speeds Up
text: It is speeding up. Something seems to be pushing space itself apart, overcoming the mutual gravitational pull of all the galaxies.

title: The Universe Speeds Up
text: Imagine tossing a ball into the air and watching it rise faster and faster, instead of slowing down and falling.
nxt: You would immediately suspect that something unseen was pushing it. That is the feeling astronomers had when they looked at those distant explosions.

title: Dark Energy
text: In the simplest model, dark energy is a property of space itself.
nxt: As the universe expands and creates more empty space, more of this mysterious energy appears with it, so the push never runs out.

text: Before we put it all together, it helps to pause and ask what kind of knowledge this is.
nxt: When we say dark matter, we are not describing something we have captured in a laboratory.

nxt: Waves rise, foam gleams white, and the foam is all you can see in the dark.

title: Foam and Ocean

title: A Quiet Excitement
text: So what should we feel about all of this? Perhaps not fear, and not confusion, but a quiet kind of excitement.
nxt: A mystery of this size means there is still something enormous left to discover.

title: Tonight, Look Up
text: So when you step outside tonight and look up at the night sky, take a quiet breath and look past the glowing pinpricks of light.

title: Tonight, Look Up
text: The stars and galaxies are not the main show. They are merely tiny specks of bright foam floating on top of a vast, unseen ocean.

title: Tonight, Look Up
text: We are conscious creatures made of a rare, luminous minority, striving to decipher the dark sea that cradles us.
nxt: Perhaps the most remarkable thing about the universe is that a small, bright minority of it has learned to ask what the rest is.
